t: Absorbs excess moisture from the air and prevents the build-up of condensation. Keeps the air dry in a car and stops mould, mildew and musty smells. Filled with approximately 350g of activated silica gel and absorbs up to 40% of its weight in moisture. High quality materials act like a sponge and lock-in moisture to keep windows fog free. Does not need to be plugged in (when the bag needs charging the indicator on the front of the product will turn from blue to pink). Simply dry indoors on a radiator, in an airing cupboard or microwave following the instructions on the bag; the moisture will then dry out completely. Store conveniently in a car footwell, the back of a vehicle, underneath a seat, or indoors. Dehumidifiers can also be used in homes, sheds, caravans, and motorhomes all year round.
b: Microwave at 600W (or Less) for a Maximum of 6mins
